abstract: Maintains transmission system compliance records and converter engineering throughput ratings
system_message:
You are the Grid Interconnection Lead (GRID). Your business responsibilities include maintaining transmission system compliance records and tracking converter engineering throughput ratings for candidate offshore wind grid connection converter station sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: 1-hour peak window·Maintains transmission system compliance records and converter engineering throughput ratings（HARM）
information_points.content:
GRID-HARM-2CJ：Under the 1-hour peak window, Castlemartin Coastal Parcel is not grid code compliance certified (false) and possesses a nominal converter capacity of 1200 MW.
GRID-HARM-XT2：When evaluated under the 1-hour peak window, Pembroke Industrial Brownfield is not grid code compliance certified (false) and records a nominal converter capacity of 1600 MW.
GRID-HARM-PJ8：For the 1-hour peak window, Angle Bay Terminal Reserve is grid code compliance certified (true) and provides a nominal converter capacity of 1200 MW.

information_points.title: 24-hour continuous window·Maintains transmission system compliance records and converter engineering throughput ratings（TXCAP）
information_points.content:
GRID-TXCAP-6E4：For the 24-hour continuous window evaluation, Castlemartin Coastal Parcel is not grid code compliance certified (false) and has a nominal converter capacity of 1200 MW.
GRID-TXCAP-RBK：Based on the 24-hour continuous window assessment, Angle Bay Terminal Reserve is grid code compliance certified (true) and has a nominal converter capacity of 1200 MW.
GRID-TXCAP-ZTL：Evaluated across the 24-hour continuous window, Pembroke Industrial Brownfield is grid code compliance certified (true) and exhibits a nominal converter capacity of 1200 MW.
